findings.text: Promotion after a clear or dismissal sets docs_stage='accepted' at holds.py:155-173 without touching edit_status, while persist_reviewed_docs updates that companion lifecycle field when it accepts (graph_ops.py:17922-17931). A held edit dismissed later therefore keeps edit_status open or exhausted after acceptance and stays advertised as unfinished. Carried from the prior review as follow-on and still unaddressed at head.

PROMOTE_STRANDED_DOCS_WHERE promotes any docs_stage='reviewed' row whose stored score clears the threshold, with no open-hold predicate, and promote_stranded_reviewed runs from the loop at loop.py:2093. A document held at reviewed with a passing judged score — the exact state this node now creates — can therefore be promoted to accepted while its ReviewHold is still open, bypassing the acceptance rule the node adds. The landing fragment names this reader as one that must adopt the predicate; the source brief deferred the change to a later node, so it is recorded rather than treated as a scope breach.
